title: Anti-Static ESD Bags (Assorted Sizes) — What ESD bags are
description: Anti-static ESD bags are metallized shielding bags that protect bare circuit boards from electrostatic discharge during storage and transport. Every spare GPU, RAM stick, and PCIe card on the bench lives in one when it is not installed.

title: Anti-Static ESD Bags (Assorted Sizes) — Shielding vs pink poly
description: Metallized shielding bags are a Faraday cage — they block external discharges — while pink poly bags are merely dissipative and slow down charge already on the surface. Pink poly is fine inside a protected area; only shielding bags travel.

title: Anti-Static ESD Bags (Assorted Sizes) — How shielding works
description: The bag's metal layer — usually aluminum a fraction of a micron thick — distributes any discharge around the outside instead of through the contents. Tests measure energy penetration in nanojoules; good shielding bags keep it under 10 nJ.

title: Anti-Static ESD Bags (Assorted Sizes) — Picking the right size
description: The rule is simple: bag length should exceed the part's longest side by about four inches, giving two inches of handling margin at each end. A 12-inch GPU wants a 12x16 bag, not a wrestling match with a 10x12.

title: Anti-Static ESD Bags (Assorted Sizes) — Film thickness in mil
